tests.title: Faster price checks (live trial)
tests.rule: Same live rule, checked every 15 minutes in the last 90 (added 75, 60 and 30 minutes before tip). These ARE real picks on the Record; this tile shows only the ones the extra checks found.
tests.discovery: Saved data: Hard Rock follows a Pinnacle move in 20-30 minutes, so wider checks missed about 5 of 6 moves.
tests.gate: Kept if it adds picks and they beat the closing line. Updated nightly.
tests.name: Faster price checks
tests.plain: Check prices every 15 minutes near tip-off
tests.why: Hard Rock copies Pinnacle in 20 to 30 minutes, so wider checks missed most moves.

tests.title: Pinnacle as the price judge
tests.rule: Hard Rock's price is 2%+ better than Pinnacle's fair price on the same line. Tracked on paper only, never the Record or Discord.
tests.gate: Live only at 150 graded, units up, and when Matt says go.
tests.name: Pinnacle price check
tests.plain: Bet when Hard Rock pays 2%+ more than Pinnacle's fair price
tests.why: Pinnacle is the sharpest book. If Hard Rock pays more, that is a bargain.

tests.title: 3-pointers: Hard Rock 1%+ over Pinnacle
tests.rule: 3-pointers only. Hard Rock's price is 1%+ better than Pinnacle's fair price on the same line, no Pinnacle move needed. Tracked on paper only.
tests.discovery: 18 nights before tracking: 17 bets 10-7 +6.15u, beat the close by 0.9%.
tests.gate: Live only at 150 graded, units up and beating the close.
tests.name: 3-pointer bargains
tests.plain: Bet 3-pointer props when Hard Rock beats Pinnacle by 1%+
tests.why: Same idea as the Pinnacle check, with a lower bar, only for 3s.

tests.title: Large unders (4+ pt move, under side)
tests.rule: Filter on the live rule's Pinnacle-move picks: Pinnacle move >= 4 pts AND side = under. Counting from Nov 10.
tests.gate: Passes only at 150 graded, profit and beating the close.
tests.name: Big move, unders only
tests.plain: Of our real picks, unders after a big line move (4+ pts)
tests.why: A big move can mean real news. We check if the under side does best.

tests.name: Late and big

tests.title: Sharp vs soft group split
tests.rule: Reads B or C. SHARP = pinnacle, novig, prophetx (>= 2 two-sided, hold 0-15%, fresh < 60 min). SOFT = draftkings, fanduel, betmgm, espnbet, betonlineag, betrivers (>= 3). sf = mean sharp fair over, tf = median soft fair over. Event abs(sf-tf) >= 0.03; side = over if sf > tf. Bet HR if EV vs sf >= 0, price -200..+200, first per player/market/night.
tests.discovery: Discovery Oct 25-Nov 14 (21 nights): 90 events, 87 graded, 49-38, +11.48u, ROI +13.2%.
tests.gate: Passes only at 150 graded forward, profit and beating close.
tests.name: Sharp vs casual books
tests.plain: Bet the way the sharp books lean when casual books disagree
tests.why: Sharp books (the ones pros use) are usually right.

tests.title: Fade soft-book move (sharp did not follow)
tests.rule: Consecutive reads, HR over and under identical. >= 3 soft and >= 2 sharp books fresh at both reads. dT = soft median fair over change, dS = sharp mean change. Event abs(dT) >= 0.02 and dS x sign(dT) < 0.005. Bet HR against the soft direction if EV vs later sharp mean >= 0, price -200..+200, first per player/market/night.
tests.discovery: Discovery Oct 25-Nov 14 (21 nights): 23 candidate pairs before EV gate; 0 clear EV >= 0 (sample too thin; sharp never pricing the fade side favorably at HR's stale price).
tests.gate: Passes only at 150 graded forward, profit and beating close.
tests.name: Against casual-book moves
tests.plain: Bet against a move that only casual books made
tests.why: If casual books move and sharp books stay put, the move may be wrong.

tests.title: Whole market moves, HR still: follow
tests.rule: Consecutive reads, HR over and under identical. Per-book fair-over change c for each fresh book at both reads. Event: >= 3 books with c >= +0.015 and none with c <= -0.015 (or mirror), and median c >= 0.02. Bet HR toward the move if EV vs later median fair >= 0, price -200..+200, first per player/market/night. Not conditioned on Pinnacle.
tests.discovery: Discovery Oct 25-Nov 14 (21 nights): 3 events, 3 graded, 1-2, -0.85u (sample too thin to judge).
tests.gate: Passes only at 150 graded forward, profit and beating close.
tests.name: Whole market moved
tests.plain: Follow a move that most books made but Hard Rock has not
tests.why: If everyone else moved, Hard Rock's price is probably out of date.

tests.title: Line vs avg: skip unders when line is 5%+ below rolling avg
tests.rule: pin_solo UNDER picks only. Skip (shadow, not live) when Pinnacle's line is 5%+ below the player's rolling season average (prior non-DNP games, min 3 prior games). Overs unchanged. Shadow tracking from 2026-11-16.
tests.discovery: Discovery Oct 25-Nov 14 (71 live picks): unders in the below-5% bucket 4-13 (23.5%, n=17 at min 3 prior games). Base under rate 50% (26-26).
tests.gate: n>=40 fresh forward under picks in the below-5% bucket (min 3 prior games), hit rate above breakeven. Post-hoc finding, forward only.
tests.name: Skip unders, low line
tests.plain: Skip Under picks when the line is well below his average
tests.why: A line far below his usual may already be too low. Early results were poor.

tests.title: Line vs avg: flag overs when line is 5%+ above rolling avg
tests.rule: pin_solo OVER picks only. Flag (shadow, not live) when Pinnacle's line is 5%+ above the player's rolling season average (prior non-DNP games, min 3 prior games). Unders unchanged. Shadow tracking from 2026-11-16.
tests.discovery: Discovery Oct 25-Nov 14 (71 live picks): overs in the above-5% bucket 8-0 (100%, n=8 at min 3 prior games). Base over rate 78.9% (15-4). Post-hoc.
tests.gate: n>=30 fresh forward over picks in the above-5% bucket (min 3 prior games), hit rate clearly above the base over rate (78.9%). Post-hoc finding, forward only.
tests.name: Overs, high line
tests.plain: Flag Over picks when the line is well above his average
tests.why: Early results: these overs won 8 of 8. That is too few to trust yet.

tests.title: Hot-form overs fade (data mining)
tests.rule: Base population: when the player's last-5-game average is 10%+ above his season average, overs miss. Points overs worst. Shadow-track from 2026-11-16. Note: LVA2 tracks overs where the LINE is 5%+ above rolling avg (8-0 discovery, overs hit) — different feature (line level vs recent output). Both tracked; DS to report overlap correlation at first scoring check.
tests.discovery: Discovery Nov 6-Nov 15 (second half only; min 5 prior games needed): overs in hot bucket n=361, 45.7% hit, -12.6% ROI, 90% CI [-21.0, -4.3]. Points hot overs n=105, 40.0%, -25.1%. Hot unders near breakeven (+0.7%).
tests.gate: n >= 300 graded forward overs in hot bucket (last-5 >= 10% above season avg, min 5 prior games). Hit rate < 50%, ROI < -5%. DS to report LVA2 overlap at the first check. If passes: Sharp reviews with DS before any live rule change.
tests.name: Hot streak overs fade
tests.plain: Bet UNDER on players who've been hot lately
tests.why: Hot streaks cool off, but books price the streak in. We bet the opposite side.

tests.title: Pinnacle 3+ pts off market = skip under (data mining)
tests.rule: Base population: when Pinnacle's de-vigged fair differs from the consensus (other books median) by 3+ pts on the bet side, unders miss badly. Likely meaning: when Pinnacle is a lone outlier vs the market, the under is a trap. Shadow-track from 2026-11-16.
tests.discovery: Discovery Oct 26-Nov 15 (base population): unders with Pinnacle 3+ pts off the market n=81, 32-49, 39.5% hit, -26.3% ROI, 90% CI [-43.2, -9.5]. Both halves negative (first half -18.1% n=50, second -39.6% n=31). Overs in same bucket +13.4% ROI but not stable across halves.
tests.gate: n >= 50 graded forward unders in the Pinnacle-outlier bucket (consensus vs Pinnacle gap >= 3 pts). Hit rate < 48%. If passes: Sharp reviews with DS before any live rule change.
tests.name: Pinnacle far from pack
tests.plain: Bet OVER instead when the Under looks like a trap
tests.why: When Pinnacle is far from the other books, the under tends to lose.
